title: Rank-and-type Fourier recurrences for quadratic-form association schemes over finite fields of characteristic two
author: Schmidt, Kai-Uwe
work: Quadratic and symmetric bilinear forms over finite fields and their association schemes
difficulty_reason: After named congruence classification of quadratic/symmetric forms and finite-field character orthogonality, the selected characteristic-two recurrences still require the new rank-constrained block parametrizations, Schur-complement rank descent and trace-sensitive Artin–Schreier evaluation. The second recurrence also requires the full singular leading-block split and two-by-two character cancellation at native483–568, rather than a routine Gauss-sum substitution. Both coupled recurrences form one independent H2 unit, with the original source shorthand disclosed.
